description: This file defines the class ExampleStorageAttributeMapper, which implements IAttributeToFactoryMapper for ExampleStorageAttribute. It maps attribute parameters to a factory method that creates storage instances within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: ExampleStorageAttributeMapper
classes.description: A mapper class that converts ExampleStorageAttribute attributes into storage factory functions for Orleans grains.

methods.name: GetFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a factory function that provides storage objects based on attribute and parameter info.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Invokes the factory method on the storage factory to create a storage instance.
